_comment: Canonical MCP set for Amp's Claude-Code harness. SSOT for ~/.claude.json mcpServers. Restorer: harness/claude-code/sync-mcp-registry.sh. Drift detector: harness/claude-code/sync-mcp-registry.sh --check. Built 2026-06-25 after the May-12-drift incident (7 guMCP entries silently disappeared); this file makes the set self-healing. NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE — the mcpgw shared token lives at ~/.config/amp/mcpgw.token (gitignored by location). internal.tools proxy entries auth via Claude Code's in-session OAuth and don't need a static token.

servers.name: glean
servers.purpose: Glean enterprise search (internal.tools proxy). search/read_document/chat across Acme's Slack/Docs/Jira/Confluence/GitHub.

servers.name: glean_default
servers.purpose: Glean direct (acme-be.glean.com). Same capabilities as above; used by some Anthropic-shipped agents that hardcode this URL.

servers.name: slack-guMCP-server
servers.purpose: Slack — 31 tools incl. send_message, archive/create_channel, get_conversation_info, list_channels, search.

servers.name: gmail-guMCP-server
servers.purpose: Gmail — 19 tools. send/forward/trash/archive/delete all hard-denied by floor; drafts allowed.

servers.name: gcalendar-guMCP-server
servers.purpose: Google Calendar — 13 tools. All writes (create/update/delete/move event, manage_attendee/acl_rule, RSVPs) hard-denied by floor; reads allowed.

servers.name: gdrive-guMCP-server
servers.purpose: Google Drive — 12 tools. Non-share writes allowed (drive_write rule); add_file_sharing_preference and bare delete hard-denied.

servers.name: gdocs-guMCP-server
servers.purpose: Google Docs — 6 tools (read_doc, create_doc, update_doc, insert_table, update_table_cell, list_tabs).

servers.name: confluence-guMCP-server
servers.purpose: Confluence — 17 tools. Writes (create/update_page, create/update_blogpost, update_task, upload_attachment) hard-denied by floor per ADR-0001; reads allowed.
